interaction.user_prompt: Hi! Please read #file:DOCUMENTATION.md . I want to add quick access / favourites menu like the left pane in nautilus file manager from gnome of windows explorer. However, it looks like intorducing sidepanes doesn't go well with the the double-pane design. Let's add a pop-up menu, that will pop up at the center of active pane with the menu containing a pre-set list of favourite directories like home, documents and downloads. Let's also add there currently mounted additional drives. Please add 2 new shortcuts - to pop up the menu and to add a dictionary the cursor is currently on to the favorites menu when navigating regularly. Also in the favorites menu there should be a shortcut to remove item from it, that will prompt a confirmation dialogue before doing so.
